note: Test-id ledger for GF-3 T1 (the fold-epoch guard requires STATS_FOLD_VERSION to rise whenever the player stats a corpus records change, reads the constant by its exact declaration, and prints it in the summary line), built against base 2e0deaa6c1 (main after #1010). Ids are relative to the engine collection ROOT. Run: node scripts/lib/test-parity.mjs --before <before-engine.json>=<base>/packages/engine --after <after-engine.json>=packages/engine --ledger this-file. Collect each side with `vitest run --isolate -t __parity_collect_only__ --reporter=json --outputFile <f>` (--isolate on BOTH sides) from the engine directory, the WHOLE package, DATABASE_URL empty. T1 adds 48 tests (6758 -> 6806 collected: 29 in test/fold-epoch-guard.test.ts, 19 in test/fold-epoch-guard-cli.test.ts), retitles and retires none; it edits the bodies (not the titles) of the existing GF-2 T4 CLI tests that move recorded stats so they also pay the new version, and the summary-line regex of tools/matrix/__tests__/ci-wiring.test.ts (outside the engine collection root; its test id is unchanged, re-run green).
